module_summary: One shift-register stage: a flip-flop with priority mux loading R when L, shifting in w when E, else holding.

anchors.name: Q
anchors.why: Shift-register stage bit; loaded, shifted or held each clock.

anchors.name: L
anchors.why: Load enable selecting R into Q; priority over shift.

anchors.name: E
anchors.why: Shift enable capturing w from previous stage.

anchors.name: w
anchors.why: Serial input from previous shift-register stage.

groups.name: shift_stage
groups.description: Load/shift/hold mux feeding the stage flip-flop Q.
